apps.description:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>软糯小团子 · 养崽模拟器</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=ZCOOL+KuaiLe&family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@400;500;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --cocoa:#2e1522;
  --cocoa-soft:rgba(46,21,34,.12);
  --paper:#fff7ec;
  --card:rgba(255,253,247,.45);
  --card-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  --straw:#f0567e; --straw-soft:rgba(255,227,236,.45);
  --mint:#3fbf9f;  --mint-soft:rgba(226,247,240,.45);
  --lemon:#ffcf5c; --lemon-soft:rgba(255,243,214,.45);
  --sky:#57c2e8;   --sky-soft:rgba(226,245,253,.45);
  --lav:#a888e6;   --lav-soft:rgba(240,232,252,.45);
  --r-lg:28px; --r-md:18px; --r-sm:12px;
  --hard:6px 7px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.16);
  --hard-s:3px 4px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.14);
  --blur:blur(0.1px) saturate(1.1);
}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
  font-family:'Noto Sans SC','PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;
  color:var(--cocoa);font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.8;overflow-x:hidden;
  background:#1a1a1a;
}
.zc{font-family:'ZCOOL KuaiLe','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.5px}
button{font-family:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none}
input,textarea{font-family:inherit;color:inherit}
::selection{background:var(--lemon)}

#bgImg{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-2;
  background-size:cover;background-position:center;background-repeat:no-repeat;
}
#bgLayer{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;overflow:hidden}
#bgLayer span{position:absolute;bottom:-8vh;animation:floatUp linear infinite;filter:saturate(.85)}
@keyframes floatUp{to{transform:translateY(-118vh) rotate(340deg)}}

.ctrl-btn{
  position:fixed;right:12px;z-index:70;
  width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);
  box-shadow:var(--hard-s);font-size:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;
  transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
}
.ctrl-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.1) rotate(-6deg)}
.ctrl-btn:active{transform:scale(.9)}
#msgToggleBtn{top:12px}
#bgmBtn{top:72px}
#bgmBtn.playing{animation:musicPulse 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes musicPulse{
  0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(240,86,126,.4),var(--hard-s)}
  50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(240,86,126,0),var(--hard-s)}
}

.ticker{
  position:relative;z-index:5;border-bottom:3px solid var(--cocoa);
  background:rgba(255,207,92,.55);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  overflow:hidden;padding-right:70px;
}
.tk-track{display:flex;width:max-content;animation:marquee 34s linear infinite;padding:8px 0}
.ticker:hover .tk-track{animation-play-state:paused}
.tk-track span{font-family:'ZCOOL KuaiLe';font-size:14.5px;white-space:nowrap;padding-right:12px;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
@keyframes marquee{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

#sidebar{
  position:fixed;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  z-index:60;display:grid;gap:9px;
}
.sbtn{
  position:relative;width:62px;padding:8px 4px 6px;
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:18px;
  background:rgba(255,253,247,.55);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:1px;box-shadow:var(--hard-s);
  transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
}
.sbtn .si{font-size:22px;line-height:1.2}
.sbtn .sl{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.sbtn:hover{transform:translateX(5px)}
.sbtn.on{background:rgba(240,86,126,.88);color:#fff;transform:translateX(7px);box-shadow:5px 6px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.25)}
.sbtn.on .sl{text-shadow:none}
.sbadge{
  display:none;position:absolute;top:-7px;right:-7px;width:20px;height:20px;
  background:#ff3b5c;color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:50%;
  font-size:12px;font-weight:900;line-height:16px;text-align:center;
  animation:pulse 1s infinite;
}
.sbadge.show{display:block}
@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(1.2)}}

.wrap{max-width:800px;margin:0 auto;padding:26px 18px 70px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.view{display:none}
.view.on{display:block;animation:viewIn .25s ease-out}
@keyframes viewIn{from{transform:translateY(10px)}to{transform:none}}

.card{
  background:var(--card);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:var(--r-lg);
  box-shadow:var(--hard),0 8px 32px rgba(46,21,34,.12);
  padding:26px 22px;margin-bottom:26px;position:relative;
}
.tape{
  position:absolute;width:98px;height:26px;top:-14px;
  background:rgba(255,207,92,.75);border:2px solid rgba(46,21,34,.3);
  transform:rotate(-4deg);
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0 8px,rgba(255,255,255,.35) 8px 10px);
}
.tape.pink{background:rgba(240,86,126,.65)}
.tape.mint{background:rgba(63,191,159,.6)}

.sec-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:20px}
.sec-badge{
  flex:0 0 auto;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-size:24px;background:rgba(255,207,92,.85);box-shadow:3px 4px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.2);
  transform:rotate(-5deg);
}
.sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(22px,5vw,28px);line-height:1.2;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.sec-head .no{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:var(--straw);letter-spacing:3px;display:block}
.sec-sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--cocoa);font-weight:600;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8)}

.kicker{
  display:inline-block;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:3px;
  background:rgba(63,191,159,.9);border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:999px;
  padding:4px 16px;box-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.2);transform:rotate(-2deg);margin-bottom:14px;
}
h1.zc{font-size:clamp(44px,10vw,72px);line-height:1.12;text-shadow:3px 3px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
h1 .deco{display:inline-block;font-size:.55em;transform:rotate(12deg) translateY(-14px)}
.tagline{margin-top:12px;font-size:clamp(15px,3.4vw,17.5px);font-weight:700;text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95)}
.tag-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:16px}
.tchip{
  font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 14px;border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);
  border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.6);box-shadow:2px 3px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.15);
  transition:transform .2s;backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
}
.tchip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(-2deg)}
.tchip.a{background:var(--straw-soft)}.tchip.b{background:var(--mint-soft)}
.tchip.c{background:var(--lemon-soft)}.tchip.d{background:var(--sky-soft)}

.notes{display:grid;gap:14px;margin-top:28px}
.note{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);padding:14px 18px;
  border-radius:6px 24px 6px 24px;box-shadow:4px 5px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.12);
  font-size:14.5px;transition:transform .25s;font-weight:600;
}
.note:hover{transform:rotate(0deg) translateY(-3px)!important}
.note:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(-.8deg);background:rgba(255,243,214,.55)}
.note:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(.6deg)}
.note:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(-.5deg);background:rgba(255,227,236,.55)}
.note:nth-child(4){transform:rotate(.7deg);background:rgba(226,247,240,.55)}
.note:nth-child(5){transform:rotate(-.6deg)}
.note b{color:#d42654}

.dev-top{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;
  padding:10px 18px;border-bottom:3px dashed rgba(46,21,34,.22);
  font-size:12px;font-weight:700;
}
.rec{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.rec i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#ff4d6d;animation:pulse2 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes pulse2{50%{opacity:.25;transform:scale(.8)}}
#clock{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;letter-spacing:1px}

.screen{
  position:relative;margin:16px 4px;border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:24px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(234,249,240,.35),rgba(253,241,244,.35) 55%,rgba(255,248,230,.35));
  backdrop-filter:var(--blur);-webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--blur);padding:22px 16px;
  display:flex;gap:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;overflow:hidden;
}
.screen::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(46,21,34,.05) 1.5px,transparent 1.5px);background-size:16px 16px;
}

.kiddo-wrap{text-align:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.kiddo{
  width:138px;height:142px;position:relative;cursor:pointer;
  margin:0 auto;
  animation:kiddoBreathe 3.5s ease-in-out infinite;
  transition:transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
}
@keyframes kiddoBreathe{
  0%,100%{transform:scale(1) translateY(0)}
  50%{transform:scale(1.02,0.98) translateY(2px)}
}
.kiddo:hover{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-2deg)}
.kiddo:active{transform:scale(.92)}

.k-ahoge{
  position:absolute;top:-24px;left:48px;width:24px;height:28px;
  border:3.5px solid var(--cocoa);border-color:var(--cocoa) transparent transparent transparent;
  border-radius:50%/20px 20px 0 0;z-index:4;
  transform:rotate(-18deg);transform-origin:bottom center;
  animation:ahogeSway 2.8s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes ahogeSway{to{transform:rotate(15deg)}}

.k-hair{
  position:absolute;top:-6px;left:8px;right:8px;height:74px;
  background:#7c5141;border:3px solid var(--cocoa);
  border-radius:65px 65px 30px 30px;z-index:1;box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.2);
}
.k-hair::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:12px;left:20px;width:30px;height:14px;
  border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.32);transform:rotate(-18deg);
}
.k-bow{
  position:absolute;top:-18px;right:6px;z-index:5;font-size:28px;
  transform:rotate(14deg);filter:drop-shadow(2px 2px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.25));
}
.k-face{
  position:absolute;top:18px;left:2px;right:2px;height:102px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff1e3,#fedcb9);
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:50% 50% 46% 46%;z-index:2;
}
.k-eye{
  position:absolute;top:44px;width:14px;height:18px;
  background:var(--cocoa);border-radius:50%;
  animation:blink 4.6s infinite;z-index:3;
}
.k-eye::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:6px;height:6px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}
.k-eye::before{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:2px;right:2px;width:3px;height:3px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-radius:50%}
.k-eye.l{left:32px}.k-eye.r{right:32px}
@keyframes blink{0%,92%,100%{transform:scaleY(1)}95%{transform:scaleY(.08)}}

.k-cheek{
  position:absolute;top:62px;width:22px;height:12px;
  background:#ff7895;opacity:.65;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(1px);z-index:3;
}
.k-cheek.l{left:16px}.k-cheek.r{right:16px}

.k-mouth{
  position:absolute;top:68px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:16px;height:10px;border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-top:none;
  border-radius:0 0 20px 20px;z-index:3;transition:all .25s;
}
.kiddo.happy .k-mouth{width:26px;height:16px;background:#f0567e;border-radius:0 0 16px 16px}
.kiddo.worried .k-mouth{width:10px;height:10px;border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:50%;background:#f7b7c6}
.kiddo.crying .k-mouth{width:16px;height:8px;border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-bottom:none;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;background:none}

.k-tear{display:none;position:absolute;top:54px;width:8px;height:12px;background:#8fd3ff;border-radius:50% 50% 60% 60%;z-index:4}
.k-tear.l{left:23px}.k-tear.r{right:23px}
.kiddo.crying .k-tear{display:block;animation:tearFall 1.1s ease-in infinite}
.kiddo.crying .k-tear.r{animation-delay:.5s}
@keyframes tearFall{0%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:0}20%{opacity:1}100%{transform:translateY(30px);opacity:0}}

.k-bib{
  position:absolute;bottom:0px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:58px;height:24px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.9);border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);
  border-radius:0 0 30px 30px;z-index:3;box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.1);
}
.k-bib::after{content:'🍳';position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:12px}
.k-hand{
  position:absolute;bottom:4px;width:15px;height:14px;
  background:#fedcb9;border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:50%;z-index:4;
}
.k-hand.l{left:22px;transform:rotate(-15deg)}
.k-hand.r{right:22px;transform:rotate(15deg)}
.k-hint{font-size:12px;margin-top:8px;color:var(--cocoa);font-weight:700;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8)}

/* ===== 浮动对话气泡 ===== */
.speech-bubble{
  position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:100px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px) scale(.85);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:22px;
  padding:14px 22px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.6;
  box-shadow:var(--hard),0 12px 40px rgba(46,21,34,.25);
  z-index:80;max-width:88vw;pointer-events:none;
  opacity:0;transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);
  text-align:center;
}
.speech-bubble.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0) scale(1)}
.speech-bubble::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  border:8px solid transparent;border-top-color:var(--cocoa);
}
.speech-bubble::before{
  content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-10px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  border:6px solid transparent;border-top-color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);z-index:1;
}
.speech-bubble.warn{background:rgba(255,243,200,.95);border-color:#b47d00;color:#7a5200}
.speech-bubble.crit{background:rgba(255,200,210,.95);border-color:var(--straw);color:#9e1239;animation:shake .45s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}25%{transform:translateX(calc(-50% - 6px))}75%{transform:translateX(calc(-50% + 6px))}}
.speech-bubble .emo{display:inline-block;margin-right:6px;transform:translateY(-1px)}

.stats{flex:1 1 280px;min-width:250px;display:grid;gap:8px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.fav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 12px;margin-bottom:4px;box-shadow:2px 3px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.1)}
.fav b{font-size:13px}
.fav .track{flex:1}
.s-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 38px;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.s-label{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.track{height:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);border:2px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}
.fill{height:100%;border-radius:99px;width:30%;transition:width .8s ease}
.s-val{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.s-row.warn .track{animation:warnPulse .8s infinite}
@keyframes warnPulse{50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(240,86,126,.4)}}
.fx-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:5}
.fheart{position:absolute;font-size:20px;animation:heartUp 1.1s ease-out forwards}
@keyframes heartUp{to{transform:translate(var(--dx),-130px) scale(1.3);opacity:0}}

.act-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(96px,1fr));gap:10px;margin-top:16px}
.act{
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
  padding:12px 6px;display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:2px;
  box-shadow:var(--hard-s);transition:transform .15s;
}
.act .ae{font-size:26px}
.act b{font-size:13px}
.act:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.act:active{transform:translateY(2px);box-shadow:2px 2px 0 rgba(46,21,34,.13)}
.act.bad{background:rgba(255,227,236,.45)}
.act.bad:hover{background:rgba(255,227,236,.65)}

.log{margin-top:16px;border:2.5px dashed rgba(46,21,34,.4);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);backdrop-filter:var(--blur)}
.log-t{font-weight:900;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:8px}
#logList{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:13px}
#logList li{border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(46,21,34,.18);padding-bottom:5px;font-weight:600}
#logList .lt{color:var(--straw);font-weight:900;margin-right:6px;font-size:11px}

.book{
  width:100%;background:var(--straw);color:#fff;border:3.5px solid var(--cocoa);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:16px;font-size:19px;font-family:'ZCOOL KuaiLe';
  box-shadow:var(--hard-s);transition:all .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1);animation:wobble 3.4s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes wobble{0%,100%{transform:rotate(-.5deg)}50%{transform:rotate(.5deg)}}
.book:hover{transform:scale(1.02)}
.book:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.fold{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .5s cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)}
.fold>.fin{overflow:hidden;min-height:0}
.fold.open{grid-template-rows:1fr}
.chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;padding:18px 0 6px}
.chip{
  border:3px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:14px 8px;
  font-family:'ZCOOL KuaiLe';font-size:15px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  box-shadow:var(--hard-s);display:grid;gap:4px;justify-items:center;
  opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px) scale(.85);
  transition:opacity .4s,transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.7,.5,1),background .2s;
  backdrop-filter:var(--blur);
}
.fold.open .chip{opacity:1;transform:none}
.fold.open .chip:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.08s}
.fold.open .chip:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.18s}
.fold.open .chip:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.28s}
.chip .ci{font-size:26px}
.chip.on{color:#fff}
.chip.c1.on{background:var(--mint)}.chip.c2.on{background:var(--straw)}.chip.c3.on{background:var(--sky)}
.chip:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.hpanel .pin{padding:6px 2px 14px}
.panel-card{border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);backdrop-filter:var(--blur);padding:18px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 6px rgba(255,207,92,.12)}
.panel-card h3{font-size:18px;margin-bottom:10px}
.tip{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:2px dashed rgba(46,21,34,.15)}
.tip:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.tip .tn{flex:0 0 auto;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lemon);border:2.5px solid var(--cocoa);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:14px}
.fx-grid{display:grid;gap:10px;max-height:390px;overflow-y:auto;padding-right:4px}
.fx{border:2px dashed rgba(46,21,34,.4);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:11px 13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.45);backdrop-filter:var(--blur)}
.fx h4{font-size:15px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.fx p{font-size:13px;color:var(--cocoa);line-height:1.7;font-weight:600}

function showSpeech(text, type='normal', emoji='💬', duration=3200){

  }
